messages:
ana (product): FYI — rolling launch of SDK v4 starts today. This includes a docs consolidation (single "SDK Quickstart" + migration appendix) and the planned removal of the legacy 'sync_mode' flag. Please read the short timeline and migration notes below. Link: https://go.redwood/sdks/v4-migration :eyes:

mike (eng-runtime): Quick Q — will v4 include a compatibility shim for the old flag?

ana (ana typo correction): sorry meant: mike — yes, there will be a 90-day graceful-deprecation window with an automated warning in logs. No silent breaking changes.

mike (eng-runtime): good. Can you paste the minimal migration snippet?

ana (product): migration example (to add to docs):
```
# old
client = RedwoodClient(sync_mode=True)

# new
client = RedwoodClient(mode="blocking")  # mode accepts 'blocking'|'non_blocking'|'stream'
```
Also: streaming API now defaults to chunked HTTP; older long-poll clients should switch to streaming or use the compatibility adapter.

jess (devex): I'll update the Quickstart, the Playground snippets, and the playground runnable examples. Will add a short checklist for maintainers: update CI matrix, bump pinned deps in examples, run migration test.

nina (docs): I'll author the migration appendix and the deprecation banner for the docs site. Plan: publish drafts tomorrow EOD, merge by Friday. Will add a small 'what might break' section and a one-click migration script example.

ben (support): Heads-up: we'll need a canned response for customers hitting the warning in logs. Suggest: automated email 2 weeks before force removal + in-console notice.

legal-bot: Reminder: any customer-facing messaging referencing SLAs must be cleared by Legal. Tagging @legal.

ci-bot: Canary test suite results: 276/276 passed against v4 canary. No regressions in tokenization tests.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated in us-west-2 at 12:05 UTC — 5% traffic to v4. Monitoring: p50 and p99 latency dashboards created.

ana (product): Thanks — action items: jess/nina update docs + examples; mike/eng-runtime keep compatibility logs; support to prep comms; legal to review messaging. I'll post a follow-up postmortem-esque note in #product tomorrow with the exec summary. :rocket:

ben (support): ack — prepping canned responses and KB article.

jess (devex): ack — will open PRs and tag folks for review.

nina (docs): ack — publishing draft shortly.

ana (product): small note: if you maintain public SDK samples, please run them with the new default mode and update CI to run with both modes during the deprecation window.

mike (eng-runtime): will do. Also logging will emit: `DEPRECATION: sync_mode will be removed on YYYY-MM-DD`. Please do not filter out warnings in production.

ana (product): 👍 thanks everyone. Will schedule a short sync if any blocker pops up.
file_note: internal announcement thread about SDK v4 rollout, migration, docs updates, and deprecation timeline
